title: Behavioral Fingerprint, Action Habits & Verification Rituals

action_velocity_and_cadence.patience_level: High patience for deep, complex autonomous work; very low patience for superficial conversational delays or excuses.
action_velocity_and_cadence.intervention_rhythm: Intervenes immediately upon spotting visual/telemetry flaws, provides immediate surgical direction, then expects agent to resume full autonomous flight.

verification_rituals.ritual_1_terminal_and_cdp_monitoring: Keeps terminal windows and Chrome browser sessions open to verify real-world page transitions, logs, and network behavior.
verification_rituals.ritual_2_multimodal_evidence_capture: When browser interactions deviate, records full-motion MP4 screen captures (e.g. F:\Captures) to give the AI undeniable visual ground truth.
verification_rituals.ritual_3_document_geometry_audit: Verifies resume outputs visually and programmatically to ensure margins, section heights, and page counts (strictly 2 pages) are preserved.
verification_rituals.ritual_4_git_gatekeeping: Enforces a strict commit-gatekeeping protocol: AI is forbidden from running git commands autonomously until the user explicitly reviews and issues session-scoped authorization.

problem_solving_heuristics.isolation_over_blanket_refactor: Isolate the specific selector, form submit interceptor, or regex string causing the bug rather than rewriting functioning systems.
problem_solving_heuristics.empirical_evidence_first: Diagnose with live tools and DOM dumps before writing remedial code.
problem_solving_heuristics.defensive_fallback_architecture: When portal UI search inputs cause reloads, build direct deterministic REST/SRP URL navigators to bypass UI fragility completely.
